skill.name: context-driven-development
skill.description: Guide Conductor context-driven development by creating, validating, and maintaining structured project context artifacts for AI-assisted coding workflows.
skill.summary: Manage Conductor project context artifacts for consistent AI-assisted development.
skill.author: sickn33

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks mark a Markdown path to an optional resource file. There is no executable Ruby, shell command, or interpolation at this location.

The line describes running a Conductor setup command in an existing project. This is procedural documentation, not embedded shell or Ruby execution.
The flagged region is a fenced Markdown directory tree. It lists context artifact names and contains no executable commands.
The static match falls on the closing Markdown code fence and nearby lifecycle text. No shell execution or dynamic command behavior is present.

content.value_statement: AI-assisted projects often lose context across sessions and contributors. This skill defines Conductor artifacts that keep product, technical, and workflow knowledge aligned.
actual_capabilities: Explains the purpose of product.md, product-guidelines.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, and tracks.md.
Guides the Context, Spec and Plan, and Implement workflow for Conductor projects.
Distinguishes greenfield setup from brownfield context extraction.
Provides a checklist for validating context before implementation starts.
Recommends maintenance practices for synchronized context artifacts and track records.
Identifies common context anti-patterns, including stale context and context sprawl.
limitations: It describes a methodology and does not include executable validators or automation scripts.
It assumes the project uses Conductor artifact names and folder conventions.
It cannot decide product goals, technical standards, or workflow policies without stakeholder input.
It does not replace project management, issue tracking, or formal architecture review.

use_cases.title: Start a New AI-Assisted Project
use_cases.description: Create initial context artifacts before implementation so AI sessions follow shared product and technical direction.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Context
use_cases.description: Align product, technology, workflow, and track documents so contributors use one source of truth.

use_cases.title: Onboard to an Existing Codebase
use_cases.description: Extract implicit context from current files and convert it into maintained Conductor artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the Method
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain context-driven development for my project. Describe each Conductor artifact and when I should update it.

prompt_templates.title: Create Initial Artifacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan initial Conductor context artifacts for a new project. Ask for missing product, technical, and workflow details.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Existing Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing project context. Identify stale, missing, or duplicated information across product, tech-stack, workflow, and tracks documents.

prompt_templates.title: Maintain Context Through Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a context maintenance process for our team. Include update triggers, review gates, ownership, and validation steps for active tracks.

output_examples.input: I am starting a new Conductor project and need the first context documents.
output: A product context outline with goals, users, features, and success metrics.
A technical context outline covering languages, dependencies, infrastructure, and quality tools.
A workflow outline for testing, reviews, commits, deployment, and track management.

output_examples.input: My team changed dependencies and shipping practices. What context needs updates?
output: Update tech-stack.md with dependency changes, version constraints, and configuration notes.
Update workflow.md with new quality gates and deployment practices.
Review active track plans for affected implementation steps.

output_examples.input: I am joining an existing project and need to understand its Conductor setup.
output: Start with index.md, then review product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, and tracks.md.
Flag outdated information before implementation work begins.
Confirm open questions with stakeholders before changing context artifacts.

best_practices: Read relevant context artifacts before planning or implementing a track.
Update context documents when product, technology, workflow, or track status changes.
Keep each artifact focused on decisions that affect AI behavior or team alignment.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before verifying that context artifacts are current.
Duplicating the same decision across several documents without a clear owner.
Creating highly detailed context that the team cannot maintain.

faq.question: What is context-driven development?
faq.answer: It is a workflow that treats project context as a maintained artifact alongside code.

faq.question: Which Conductor files does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers product.md, product-guidelines.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md, and related track documents.

faq.question: Can this skill create files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for creating and maintaining files, but it does not include automation scripts.

faq.question: When should context documents be updated?
faq.answer: Update them when product goals, dependencies, workflows, active tracks, or team decisions change.

faq.question: Is this useful for existing projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to extract implicit context from code, configuration, and current documentation.

faq.question: Does this skill work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for structured development guidance.
